name.zh: 版画质感 · 奇幻绘本

classification.zh: 水粉／粉彩干刷效果与版画装饰语言结合的当代奇幻绘本插画
classification.en: Contemporary fantasy storybook illustration combining gouache- and pastel-like dry-brush effects with the decorative language of printmaking

summary.zh: 不透明的粗颗粒颜料效果、刻线般的植物剪影与小比例人物，让环境参与叙事。冷绿蓝色盘中，橙红色承担情绪焦点。
summary.en: Opaque, coarsely textured paint effects, incised-looking plant silhouettes and small-scale figures make the environment part of the storytelling. Orange-red carries the emotional focus within a cool green and blue palette.

recognition.zh: 看干性颗粒、平面剪影与排线的结合，再看人物与环境比例。比笼统的“水彩风”更贴近这组参考。
recognition.en: Look at the combination of dry grain, flat silhouettes and hatching, then at the scale of the figures relative to the environment. This describes the reference set more closely than the broad label “watercolor style.”

reuse_focus.zh: 先组织大块明暗、人物焦点和引导线，再加干刷颗粒与刻线。保留目标照片的视角和画幅。
reuse_focus.en: First organize broad light and dark masses, the focal figure and leading lines, then add dry-brush grain and incised-looking lines. Keep the target photograph’s viewpoint and framing.

judgment_note.zh: 水粉、粉彩和版画描述可见效果；作品可能使用数字笔刷，实际媒介待补。
judgment_note.en: Gouache, pastel and printmaking describe visible effects; the works may use digital brushes, and their actual media remain unverified.

alt.zh: 高俯视的草地中，披红斗篷的旅人带着白马沿河边前行
alt.en: Seen from a high angle, a red-cloaked traveler accompanies a white horse along a river through a meadow

focus.zh: 抒情田园；草地笔触与色彩节奏。
focus.en: Lyrical pastoral mood; brushwork in the grass and rhythmic color.

alt.zh: 幽暗蓝色森林中，冒险者在橙红色篝火旁休息

focus.zh: 幽暗童话；冷蓝与暖色火光对照。
focus.en: A dark fairy-tale mood; cool blue contrasts with warm firelight.

alt.zh: 蓝白色森林雪道中，背着长剑的人物沿红色痕迹向前行走
alt.en: On a snowy path through a blue-and-white forest, a figure carrying a long sword on their back walks forward along red traces

focus.zh: 道路与红色痕迹引导视线，叙事最明确。
focus.en: The path and red traces guide the eye; this image has the clearest narrative.

alt.zh: 小比例矮人站在浅色石台上，下方深蓝水面有红鱼和圆形荷叶

focus.zh: 平面装饰性最强；排线、石阶与荷叶呼应。
focus.en: The strongest flat decorative quality in the set; hatching, stone steps and lotus leaves echo one another.

text.zh: 不透明色块、干刷露底、粉彩般擦痕与粗纹纸颗粒叠加，边缘有断裂和毛糙感。
text.en: Opaque color blocks, dry-brush marks that reveal the ground, pastel-like scuffs and coarse paper grain overlap, with broken, rough-looking edges.

text.zh: 人物以轮廓、披风和装备表达身份，面部简化；蕨叶、草束和荷叶转化为重复图形。
text.en: Figures convey their identities through contours, cloaks and equipment, with simplified faces; fern fronds, tufts of grass and lotus leaves become repeated shapes.

text.zh: 植物剪影、岩壁排线与刻印般的边缘带来版画气质，同时保留松动的绘画笔触。
text.en: Plant silhouettes, hatching on rock faces and incised-looking edges evoke printmaking, while loose painted brushwork remains visible.

text.zh: 墨绿、蓝绿和深蓝建立环境；橙红形成人物或叙事焦点，纸白为视线提供停顿。
text.en: Dark green, blue-green and deep blue establish the environment; orange-red creates a focal figure or narrative focus, and paper white gives the eye places to rest.

text.zh: 原参考采用狭长竖幅与高俯视，用河岸、烟、道路和石阶引导视线；人物较小，环境显得辽阔。
text.en: The original references use narrow portrait formats and high-angle views, guiding the eye with riverbanks, smoke, paths and stone steps; the small figures make the environments feel expansive.

legacy_prompts.zh: 将输入照片改绘为版画质感的当代奇幻绘本插画。照片提供内容、视角和构图，风格参考只提供色彩、笔触和图形语言。保留原图主体数量、人物身份与姿态、关键物件、空间关系和画幅比例。用不透明水粉与粉彩般的干刷擦痕重绘全场，显露粗纹纸颗粒与断裂边缘；在树干、岩石及既有表面使用细排线和刻印般纹理，把植物概括为清晰剪影与重复图案。以墨绿、蓝绿和深蓝组织大块明暗，用原图已有暖色主体建立少量橙红焦点，并保留纸白般的亮部停顿。简化次要人物细节，但保持主角可辨认，面部与环境使用同一绘画语言。用原有道路、河岸或形体方向引导视线，不强行改为高俯视镜头。不要从参考导入武器、鱼群、火堆、雪地或新角色；不要添加文字、水印、摄影贴片、塑料光泽或均匀噪点滤镜。
legacy_prompts.en: Reinterpret the input photograph as a contemporary fantasy storybook illustration with printmaking-like texture. The photograph supplies content, viewpoint and composition; style references supply only color, brushwork and graphic language. Preserve the original subject count, people’s identities and poses, key objects, spatial relationships and aspect ratio. Repaint the entire scene with opaque gouache- and pastel-like dry-brush scuffs, revealing coarse paper grain and broken edges; use fine hatching and incised-looking textures on tree trunks, rocks and existing surfaces, and simplify plants into clear silhouettes and repeated patterns. Organize broad light and dark masses in dark green, blue-green and deep blue, use existing warm-colored subjects for a few orange-red focal points, and retain paper-white-like highlights as visual pauses. Simplify details of secondary figures while keeping the main figure recognizable, using the same painted language for faces and the environment. Guide the eye with existing paths, riverbanks or the directions of forms, without forcing a high-angle camera view. Do not import weapons, groups of fish, campfires, snowy ground or new characters from the references. Do not add text, watermarks, photographic patches, plastic gloss or a uniform noise filter.

observed_avoid.zh: 避免用均匀噪点代替笔触、让透明水彩洇染成为主体，或照搬参考中的武器、鱼群、雪地和火堆。
observed_avoid.en: Avoid replacing brushwork with uniform noise, making transparent watercolor bleeding the dominant effect, or directly copying weapons, groups of fish, snowy ground and campfires from the references.

avoid.zh: 不新增原图没有的人物、建筑、动物或道具；不复制参考图题字与水印；避免细节密度平均、材质噪声过重
avoid.en: Do not add people, buildings, animals or props absent from the source; do not copy reference lettering or watermarks; avoid uniform detail density and excessive texture noise
